title: Canonical Learner Envelope and Serialized Persistence

preflight.note: Registered before implementation in a clean isolated public worktree at exact base 927a57c9119d24581e8fe3fc1f1bd68e7ab1d0af after verifying WI324-WI329 were free. The shared dirty checkout, WI323 worktree, private repository, installed application, and preserved learner backup are out of scope.

acceptance_criteria.text: One canonical PlatformLearnerEnvelope owner hydrates and sanitizes the persisted envelope once, exposes readiness and snapshots, and is the sole in-memory authority for platform course state.
PlatformHub cannot mutate learner state before hydration; a bounded initialization state prevents defaults from replacing persisted state, while unrelated shell functionality remains usable.
All envelope mutations use one serialized pipeline, so overlapping progress changes observe prior committed changes and retain all updates.
Callers can distinguish pending, durably persisted, and failed mutations; persistence failures are observable and in-memory updates are not represented as durable success.
PlatformHub consumes the hydrated owner and requests mutations through it; no independent envelope load, read/merge/write, or discarded save promise remains there.

Native platform-state writes are serialized within the app process, use protected temporary writes, complete writes before replacement, use atomic replacement where supported, and propagate bounded errors.

Existing schema-1 envelopes and multiple course namespaces load and save compatibly; valid course progress, package identity, lecture slots, lab slots, and compatible unknown fields are preserved, while malformed/conflicting state fails recoverably without destroying the prior valid state.

A bounded flush waits for pending canonical mutations during supported normal shutdown; failure is observable and shutdown cannot hang indefinitely. Any native lifecycle limit is documented with the strongest supported boundary implemented.
Academic Record remains a derived projection of authored catalog data and the authoritative hydrated CourseProgress snapshot; no separate Academic Record persistence authority is introduced.
A deterministic future migration boundary is documented without moving legacy learner progress, changing the namespace, or altering apex-state, legacy course-progress keys, or the course registry.

Neutral public tests cover hydration-before-mutation, stale-default protection, overlapping mutation retention and order, surfaced save failure and durability state, schema-1 and multiple namespaces, preservation after failure, flush ordering, native write safety where testable, and absence of PlatformHub read/merge/write.
Guided-practice, assessment success, remediation/retry, and module-assessment regression tests remain green using public-safe fixtures only.

Public validation, evidence, and privacy scans pass; WI325-WI329 are registered as proposed follow-ups; implementation stops for independent review without merging, release packaging, installation, private-course changes, installed acceptance, or learner-backup changes.

source: User-authorized WI324 Canonical Learner Envelope Persistence Foundation implementation request and accepted persistence/state-authority discovery.
